_doc: Vellmarch, the post-game Era II region (scripts/core/Region2.gd, tests/unit/test_region2.gd). Opens with the flag in unlock_flag after the finale and is drawn in Era II (limited colour, era2 art). Towns and routes carry grid cells for a later world_layout.json entry; maps are built from this sheet. Encounter slots with species null are reserved for Vellmarch's own Spirlings (they come later); until then stand_in names an existing Spirling whose Era II art is shown. Wardens hold the four Rifts; every chapter of the arc has at least one betrayal. Rust and Mask are the region's elements (data/type_chart.json). Rings 52 to 70.
name: Vellmarch

arrival.text: The night barge takes no fare. The bargeman just says the House already paid.

towns.name: Cindergate Quay
towns.text: Docks, smoke and a toll booth that charges you for looking at it.

towns.name: Tallowmarket
towns.text: Candles by day, rumours by night. Both are sold by weight.

towns.name: Hookwick
towns.text: A fishing town where every boat has two owners and one of them is lying.

towns.name: Larkspur Heights
towns.text: Clean streets, high walls. The money here never touches the ground.

towns.name: Lastlamp
towns.text: The last lit street before the marsh. Nobody here asks your name twice.

wardens.name: Warden Odile
wardens.intro: You came all this way for a lock keeper? Sweet. The House pays me to lose slowly.
wardens.defeat: Fine. Take the key. Just know I already sold a copy.

wardens.name: Warden Brannoc
wardens.intro: My furnace, my rules. The rules say you burn.
wardens.defeat: You beat the foundry. Now guess who told the Syndicate you were coming.

wardens.name: Warden Sable
wardens.intro: Everyone in this opera wears a face. Mine is the only honest one, and it is fake.
wardens.defeat: Bravo. Now take off yours. Oh. You were never wearing one. How dull.

wardens.name: Warden Corin
wardens.intro: I funded the barge, the bribes and your little tour. Every coin comes home, kid.
wardens.defeat: Keep the vault. I keep the town. Nobody wins clean in Vellmarch.

story.title: Chapter 1: A Free Ride
story.text: Fixer Wren Marlow meets you off the barge with a grin and a map. The House of Corin wants the Rifts closed, and they pay well.

betrayal.text: The free barge was a delivery: you. The bargeman gets paid twice, once by each House.

story.title: Chapter 2: Wet Keys
story.text: The canal locks bleed water into the street. Odile keeps the Lock Rift and the only key.

betrayal.text: Odile copied the key and sold it to the Tallow Syndicate before she even fought you.

story.title: Chapter 3: Hot Metal
story.text: Rust eats the foundry from the inside. Brannoc says the Syndicate did it. The Syndicate says Brannoc did.

betrayal.text: Your fixer Wren tipped off the Syndicate. Her cut was your route, your team and your bedtime.

story.title: Chapter 4: Faces
story.text: At the masked opera every guest is someone else. Sable offers a truce, a drink and a lie, in that order.

betrayal.text: The Syndicate sells Wren out in turn. She ends up at your door with nothing but a sorry and a spare key.

story.title: Chapter 5: Every Coin Comes Home
story.text: The vault under Lastlamp hums with stolen colour. The man who paid for your barge waits inside.

betrayal.text: Corin never wanted the Rifts closed. He wanted them owned. Trust no one, least of all your sponsor.
